description: Java source code for the ViewLoader class, responsible for loading and creating view instances, handling class loading, resource parsing, and error reporting within the Android layout preview environment.

classes.name: ViewLoader
classes.description: Handles dynamic loading and instantiation of Android views for layout preview, resource parsing, and class management.

methods.name: loadView
methods.description: Loads and creates an instance of a view class by name, with specified constructor signature and arguments, with fallback to superclass or mock view.

methods.name: loadClass
methods.description: Loads a class by name using a project-specific class loader, with error handling and logging.

methods.name: createViewFromSuperclass
methods.description: Attempts to instantiate a view by traversing superclasses if the class itself cannot be instantiated.

methods.name: createMockView
methods.description: Creates a placeholder mock view with label and optional gravity for preview purposes.

methods.name: getModule
methods.description: Returns the module associated with this ViewLoader.

methods.name: getShortClassName
methods.description: Generates a shortened, readable class name for display in the UI.

methods.name: createNewInstance
methods.description: Uses reflection to instantiate a class with specified constructor signature and arguments, handling various constructor overloads.

methods.name: getRClassName
methods.description: Retrieves the fully qualified R class name for resource referencing based on the module's manifest package.

methods.name: loadAndParseRClassSilently
methods.description: Attempts to load and parse the R class silently, updating the resource repository and logging errors.

methods.name: loadAndParseRClass
methods.description: Loads and parses the R class to extract resource IDs and references, updating the app resource repository.

methods.name: parseClass
methods.description: Parses the R class's nested classes to extract resource IDs and styleable resources.
